components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action to press. Forge Gold, lifts on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">สร้างฉากใหม่</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:36px; padding:0 16px; border:0; border-radius:4px; background:var(--primary, oklch(0.75 0.18 85)); color:var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.12 0.02 85)); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:oklch(0.75 0.18 85 / 0.9); transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:0 4px 12px oklch(0.75 0.18 85 / 0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px oklch(0.75 0.18 85 / 0.5); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action; seam border turns gold on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:36px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.28 0.015 250)); border-radius:4px; background:var(--background, oklch(0.12 0.015 250)); color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.93 0.01 85)); font-size:14px; font-weight:500; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor:pointer; transition:all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:var(--accent, oklch(0.24 0.02 85)); border-color:oklch(0.75 0.18 85 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px oklch(0.75 0.18 85 / 0.5); }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: Toolbar default; no border until hovered.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost" aria-label="เพิ่มเติม"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="12" cy="5" r="1"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1"/><circle cx="12" cy="19" r="1"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:32px; height:32px; border:0; border-radius:4px; background:transparent; color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.93 0.01 85)); cursor:pointer; transition:background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:var(--accent, oklch(0.24 0.02 85)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px oklch(0.75 0.18 85 / 0.5); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Seam border; gold border, ring and ember glow on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { height:36px; width:260px; padding:4px 12px; border:1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.18 0.015 250)); border-radius:4px; background:oklch(0.18 0.015 250 / 0.3); color:var(--foreground, oklch(0.93 0.01 85)); font-size:14px; outline:none; transition:all 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.65 0.02 250)); } .ds-input:hover { border-color:oklch(0.65 0.02 250 / 0.5); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:oklch(0.75 0.18 85); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px oklch(0.75 0.18 85 / 0.3), 0 0 10px oklch(0.75 0.18 85 / 0.15); }

components.name: Technical Badge
components.description: Stamped mono label for counts and codes.
components.css: .ds-badge-tech { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:2px 8px; border:1px solid var(--steel-600, oklch(0.45 0.02 250)); border-radius:4px; color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.65 0.02 250)); font-family:var(--font-jetbrains, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size:10px; letter-spacing:0.05em; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.name: Scene Card
components.description: Plot board scene card: full seam border, amber on hover, ring when selected.
components.css: .ds-scene-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; width:240px; padding:10px 12px; text-align:left; border:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.28 0.015 250)); border-radius:6px; background:var(--card, oklch(0.16 0.015 250)); color:var(--card-foreground, oklch(0.93 0.01 85)); cursor:pointer; transition:border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-scene-card:hover { border-color:oklch(0.68 0.17 70 / 0.5); } .ds-scene-card:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px oklch(0.68 0.17 70); } .ds-scene-title { font-size:14px; font-weight:600; } .ds-scene-sum { font-size:12px; color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.65 0.02 250)); } .ds-scene-meta { font-size:11px; color:var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.65 0.02 250)); }

narrative.overview:
Mythoria is a workshop, not an office. Iron-dark surfaces, gold that only lights where work is happening, and technical labels that read like stamped markings on a tool. The forge is the identity; the writing is the work. Dashboards, sidebars and the plot board wear the forge openly. The editor and long-reading surfaces step back to a clean, calm canvas, because "Forge Mode is earned, not imposed."

Density is high and the system pays for it with quiet surfaces: thin seams instead of heavy boxes, muted text for metadata, gold reserved for the one thing to press. Components are flat at rest; they answer the cursor with a gold border, a lift of 1px, a faint amber glow. Nothing glows when nobody is touching it.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first iron neutrals tinted toward blue-steel (hue 250); warm gold accent (hue 85).
Gold is an action color, not decoration.
Flat surfaces, 1px seams, small radii (4px default).
Outfit for display, Geist for UI, Sarabun for Thai prose, JetBrains Mono for stamped technical labels.
Forge ornaments (chamfered corners, hazard stripes, noise, glow) exist as utilities and are used sparingly, on identity surfaces only.
Thai-first: every label, state and empty message is written in Thai.

rules.name: The Gold Means Go Rule
rules.body: Forge Gold marks what the writer can act on or what is currently selected. It never fills a decorative surface, never colors a heading for flair, and covers ≤10% of any screen.

rules.name: The Tone Color Belongs To The Story Rule
rules.body: User-chosen tone colors (idea cards, lanes, threads) are content, not chrome. Show them as a full tinted border, a dot, or a soft background tint. Never let them compete with Forge Gold for "this is the action."

rules.name: The Thai Floor Rule
rules.body: Thai text never drops below 11px, and running Thai text never below 12px. Thai stacked vowels and tone marks collapse first; 9–10px is reserved for Latin numerals only.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Technical mono labels mark data (counts, IDs, frame numbers). They are not section eyebrows. One stamp per region, not one above every heading.

rules.name: The Cold Iron Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are cold at rest. Heat (gold glow, lift) appears only while the cursor or focus is on the element, and disappears when it leaves.

dos: Do keep Forge Gold (oklch(0.75 0.18 85)) for primary actions, selection and focus only, ≤10% of the screen.
Do build depth with the Night Iron tonal steps (0.10 / 0.12 / 0.16 / 0.18) before reaching for a shadow.
Do write every label, empty state and error in Thai first.
Do keep Thai text ≥11px and running Thai text ≥12px.
Do step the forge back in writing surfaces: Sarabun at 16px / 1.8, max 75ch, no ornaments.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce fallback.
Do hide secondary card actions (⋮ menus) until hover/focus on fine pointers, and keep them always visible on touch.
donts: Don't look like Notion: identity-free, gray-on-white flatness with no forge at all.
Don't look like Google Docs: zero personality.
Don't look like Scrivener: dated, dense chrome that isn't intuitive.
Don't drift into the generic SaaS cream/beige AI template look. Do not warm or saturate Ash Light further.
Don't use border-left or border-right wider than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards, list items or callouts. Use a full border, a tint, or a leading dot.

Don't put Glow Gold, hazard stripes, noise textures or chamfered corners on dense working UI (board cards, panels, forms). They are identity ornaments for the landing, dashboard hero and forge buttons.
Don't put a mono uppercase stamp above every section heading.
Don't use gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, or nested cards.
Don't use Quench Red for anything except destruction and errors.
